blocks.prompt: 9 The members of a club are 10 boys and 8 girls. In how many ways can a committee of 6 boys and 3 girls be formed?
blocks.explanation:
Committee ek selection hai: kaun kis tarteeb se chuna gaya, is se farq nahi parta.
Find kya karna hai? 10 larkon mein se 6 aur 8 larkiyon mein se 3 ek saath chunne ke tareeqe.
Plan: \({}^{10}C_{6} \times {}^{8}C_{3}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 10 boys, 8 girls; committee mein 6 boys aur 3 girls.
Humein find karna hai: kitni committees ban sakti hain.
Tareeqa: Boys aur girls alag alag chune jayenge (dono combinations), aur kyunke dono kaam ek saath hone hain, is liye un ko multiply karenge.

Boys chunein
\[{}^{10}C_{6} = {}^{10}C_{4}\]
\[= \dfrac{10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7}{4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{5040}{24} = 210\]
Kyun: 6 boys committee mein lena aur 4 boys bahar chhorna ek hi faisla hai. Is liye \({}^{10}C_{6} = {}^{10}C_{4}\), aur 4 factors ka hisaab 6 factors se aasaan hai.

Girls chunein
\[{}^{8}C_{3} = \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 56\]
Kyun: 8 girls mein se 3; neeche ka \(3! = 6\) upar ke 6 se cancel ho jata hai aur \(8 \times 7 = 56\) bachta hai.

Multiply karein
\[210 \times 56 = 200 \times 56 + 10 \times 56\]
\[= 11200 + 560 = 11760\]
Kyun: Har boys wala group har girls wale group ke saath committee bana sakta hai. 210 ko \(200 + 10\) mein tor kar multiply kiya taake zehni hisaab aasaan ho.
Dhyan dein: Aakhir mein zero na chhoot jaye; \(210 \times 56\) ka jawab paanch digits ka hai.

Tasdeeq
\[11760 \div 56 = 210 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Ulta divide karne par boys wali ginti wapas aa gayi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key 1176 likhti hai. Yeh misprint hai (ek zero reh gaya): \({}^{10}C_{6} \times {}^{8}C_{3} = 210 \times 56 = 11760\). Sahi jawab 11,760 hai.
